intro_payload.title: Biomolecules: sharir ke zaroori molecules
intro_payload.subtitle: Food se cells tak: zero se Railway basics aur advanced links
learning_outcomes: Biomolecule, element aur monomer ke seedhe meaning
Carbohydrate, lipid, protein aur nucleic acid ke kaam
Food tests aur digestion ke main steps
Railway facts, basic bonds aur advanced biological links

learning_path.title: Zero/Foundation
learning_path.description: Class 8 level se shuru: pehle seedha matlab, zaroori shabd aur daily-life example.

learning_path.title: Railway Basic
learning_path.description: RRB Group D/NTPC ke direct facts, units, formula aur simple applications.

learning_path.title: Railway Application
learning_path.description: Mixed examples aur common exam confusions ko step by step solve karo.

learning_path.title: Advanced
learning_path.description: Mechanism, exceptions aur multi-step reasoning; har naya term pehle define hoga.

learning_path.title: Advanced Challenge
learning_path.description: Hard practice aur detailed explanations; pehle ke concepts ka use karke solve karo.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Biomolecules woh molecules hain jo jeevit cells mein milte hain ya unke kaam mein madad karte hain. Seedha example: roti ka starch, tel ka fat, dal ka protein aur cells ka DNA—sab biomolecules hain. Inmein aam taur par carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen hote hain; proteins aur nucleic acids mein nitrogen bhi hota hai. Railway point: chaar bade groups yaad rakho—carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, nucleic acids. Advanced link: chhote building blocks judkar bade molecules bana sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki Biomolecules woh molecules hain jo jeevit cells mein milte hain ya unke. Kya main sahi samjha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Carbohydrates sharir ko jaldi istemal hone wali energy dete hain. Glucose ek simple sugar hai; starch chawal/roti mein milta hai; cellulose paudhon ki cell wall ko majbooti deta hai. Railway point: plants starch store karte hain, animals glycogen store karte hain. Advanced link: simple sugars monosaccharides, do sugars disaccharides, aur bahut se sugar units polysaccharides kehlate hain; unke beech glycosidic bond hota hai.

quiz_payload.question: Roti mein energy dene wala mukhya carbohydrate kaunsa hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Roti mein starch hota hai. Digestion ke baad starch chhote sugars, aakhir mein glucose, mein toot sakta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Lipids mein fats, oils aur waxes aate hain. Ye energy ko store karte hain, thand se bachane mein madad karte hain, aur cell membrane ka ek hissa banate hain. Railway point: fats paani mein ghulte nahi; kai oils room temperature par liquid aur kai fats solid hote hain. Advanced link: triglyceride glycerol aur fatty acids se banta hai; phospholipid ki water-loving head aur water-avoiding tails membrane ki double layer banati hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ise ek chhote example se samjha sakte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Proteins sharir ki banawat aur kaam dono mein madad karte hain—muscle, skin, kuch hormones aur antibodies mein protein hota hai. Dal, anda aur doodh protein ke food sources hain. Protein ke building blocks amino acids hain; amino acids peptide bonds se judte hain. Advanced link: amino-acid sequence protein ki folding aur shape ko prabhavit karti hai; shape badle to protein ka kaam bhi badal sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki Proteins sharir ki banawat aur kaam dono mein madad karte hain—muscle. Kya main sahi samjha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

quiz_payload.question: Protein ke building blocks kya kehlate hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Amino acids peptide bonds se judkar protein banate hain. Fatty acids aam taur par lipids ka hissa hote hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Enzyme cell ka biological helper hai jo reaction ko jaldi karata hai. Amylase saliva mein starch todne mein madad karta hai. Enzyme khud reaction ke baad khatam nahi hota. Railway point: adhiktar enzymes proteins hote hain aur har enzyme kuch khaas substrate par kaam karta hai. Advanced link: enzyme activation energy kam karta hai; bahut zyada heat ya galat pH uski shape bigaad sakta hai, isliye kaam ruk sakta hai.

messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki Enzyme cell ka biological helper hai jo reaction ko jaldi karata hai.. Kya main sahi samjha?

quiz_payload.question: Enzyme reaction ko tez kaise karta hai?

options.text: Har substrate ko ek hi product bana kar

quiz_payload.explanation: Enzyme reaction ka rasta aasaan karke activation energy kam karta hai. Wo khud reaction mein permanently consume nahi hota.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: DNA aur RNA nucleic acids hain. DNA mein cells ki hereditary instructions hoti hain; RNA un instructions ko use karke protein banane mein madad karta hai. Nucleotide inka chhota unit hai. Railway point: DNA mein deoxyribose sugar, RNA mein ribose sugar hoti hai; DNA mein thymine aur RNA mein aam taur par uracil hota hai. Advanced link: nucleotide mein sugar, phosphate aur nitrogen base hota hai; nucleotides phosphodiester bonds se judte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki DNA aur RNA nucleic acids hain.. Kya main sahi samjha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

quiz_payload.question: RNA mein DNA ke thymine ki jagah aam taur par kaunsa base hota hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: RNA mein uracil hota hai; DNA mein aam taur par thymine hota hai. Dono mein adenine, guanine aur cytosine bhi milte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cell ko kaam karne ke liye usable energy chahiye. ATP ek chhota molecule hai jo cell mein energy transfer karta hai—ise energy-carrying molecule samjho, battery ki tarah. ATP tootkar ADP aur phosphate banata hai, to energy release hoti hai. Advanced link: respiration se nikli energy ka kuch hissa ATP banane mein lagta hai; muscles, transport aur synthesis jaise kaam ATP use karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki Cell ko kaam karne ke liye usable energy chahiye.. Kya main sahi samjha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Vitamins aur minerals kam matra mein chahiye, par body ke normal kaam ke liye zaroori hote hain. Vitamin C ki kami se scurvy aur vitamin D ki kami se bachchon mein rickets ho sakta hai. Iron haemoglobin banane mein kaam aata hai. Railway point: vitamins energy ka direct main source nahi; wo body ke processes ko sahi chalane mein madad karte hain.

messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki Vitamins aur minerals kam matra mein chahiye. Kya main sahi samjha?

quiz_payload.question: Vitamin C ki kami se kaunsi disease ho sakti hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Scurvy vitamin C ki kami se hota hai. Rickets aam taur par bachchon mein vitamin D ki kami se sambandhit hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Food ke kuch molecules ko simple tests se pehchana ja sakta hai. Iodine solution starch ke saath blue-black ho sakta hai. Biuret reagent protein ke saath violet/purple rang deta hai. Oil/grease ka translucent spot bhi lipid ka simple clue hai. Test karte waqt reagent ko nahi chakhna—ye laboratory chemicals ho sakte hain. Advanced link: test ka rang kisi molecule ke saath reagent ki reaction se badalta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Digestion bade food molecules ko chhote absorbable units mein todta hai. Amylase starch par, proteases proteins par aur lipase fats par kaam karte hain. Chhote products intestine se blood ya lymph mein absorb ho sakte hain. Railway point: bile enzyme nahi hota; bile fat ko chhoti droplets mein baantkar lipase ke liye surface badhata hai. Advanced link: chemical digestion hydrolysis se bonds todta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Bile ka ek main kaam kya hai?

options.text: Fat ko chhoti droplets mein baantna
Protein ko amino acids mein todna

quiz_payload.explanation: Bile fat ko emulsify karta hai—badi boondon ko chhoti boondon mein baantta hai. Bile khud digestive enzyme nahi hota.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Protein ki 3-D shape uske kaam ke liye zaroori hai. Bahut zyada heat ya bahut acidic/basic condition se protein ki shape bigad sakti hai; ise denaturation kehte hain. Anda pakne par egg-white ka protein badalna ek daily example hai. Advanced link: denaturation mein aksar amino-acid sequence nahi tootati, par protein ki folded shape aur function bigad sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki Protein ki 3-D shape uske kaam ke liye zaroori hai.. Kya main sahi samjha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: DNA ka ek hissa gene kehlata hai. Cell gene ki information se pehle RNA copy banata hai; phir ribosome RNA ko padhkar amino acids ko sahi order mein jodta hai. Is tarah protein banta hai. Is flow ko simple roop mein DNA → RNA → protein likhte hain. Advanced link: mutation DNA sequence badal sakti hai; asar neutral, harmful ya kabhi useful ho sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, aapne abhi kaha ki DNA ka ek hissa gene kehlata hai.. Kya main sahi samjha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Pehle basic idea yaad rakho, phir Railway ke fact aur advanced link ko usi se jodo.

quiz_payload.question: DNA → RNA → protein ke simple flow mein protein banane ki jagah kaunsi cell structure hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Ribosome RNA ki information padhkar amino acids jodta hai. Isliye protein synthesis ka main site ribosome hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 1: Kitchen mein kisi food sample par iodine solution daalne se blue-black rang aaya. Kaunsa molecule present ho sakta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Iodine starch ke saath blue-black colour deta hai; test sample ko khana nahi chahiye.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 2: Dal ke protein ko digestion ke baad chhote building blocks mein todna hota hai. Kaunsa enzyme group kaam karega?
quiz_payload.explanation: Proteases proteins ko peptides/amino acids mein todte hain; amylase starch par, lipase fats par kaam karta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 3: Bukhar mein bahut high temperature se enzyme kaam karna band kar sakta hai. Iska likely reason kya hai?

options.text: Enzyme ki 3-D shape badal sakti hai
Substrate mass zero ho jaata hai

quiz_payload.explanation: High heat protein enzyme ki shape/active site ko bigaad sakti hai; ise denaturation kehte hain.

revision_points.point: Glucose simple sugar hai; starch plants ka storage carbohydrate, glycogen animals ka storage carbohydrate, cellulose plant cell wall ka structural part hai.
Energy storage, insulation aur membranes; triglyceride glycerol + fatty acids se banta hai.
Proteins amino acids se bante hain. Enzymes biological catalysts hain; heat/pH se unki shape badal sakti hai.
Dono nucleotide polymers hain. DNA mein deoxyribose/thymine; RNA mein ribose/uracil.
Iodine + starch → blue-black; Biuret + protein → violet; bile fat emulsify karta hai, enzyme nahi.
DNA → RNA → protein; ATP cell ke kaamon ke liye energy transfer karta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Kaunsa pair sahi hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Starch iodine ke saath blue-black rang deta hai. Protein ka Biuret test violet hota hai. Bile enzyme nahi, aur DNA nucleotides ka polymer hai.
